title: AutoGen: GroupChat with Shared Messages
description: AssistantAgent and UserProxyAgent in a GroupChat where all agents share the same messages list, with GroupChatManager deciding who speaks next.

steps.description: Three agents: researcher and drafter as AssistantAgent, critic as UserProxyAgent with NEVER human input mode.
Researcher: AssistantAgent with system message for searching and retrieving passages.
Drafter: AssistantAgent with system message for writing from provided passages.
Critic: UserProxyAgent with system message for identifying weaknesses, no human input, no code execution.
GroupChat: agents list, empty messages, max_round=6 to prevent infinite loops.
Manager: GroupChatManager with the groupchat, then researcher initiates the chat with the question.
